iut_type: End Product (Paramount Bed restroom/toilet usage sensor) — proxy registration account naming
customer_question: We've historically registered with Bluetooth SIG under a 'Hosokawa'-named account, so we issued this Invoice under that same name again. If we instead wanted to register under a different person's name (e.g. Nagase), would that require setting up a new SIG User Name, and would the proxy registration confirmation document need to be redone?
question_variants: Does the Invoice-issuing account need to match the registration login account?
Can registration proceed under a different user's name than the one the Invoice was issued under?
actual_issue: The customer's Invoice for the Qualification Fee was issued under an existing 'Hosokawa' SIG account by historical convention, and the customer wanted to know whether they could instead register under a different employee's name, and what that would require.
plain_english_explanation: The login account used to issue the Invoice must match the login account used to perform the actual registration, because the Receipt Number generated for that Invoice can only be used for registration under the same account. If the customer wants to register under a different person's name, that person would first need to obtain their own valid SIG login account, after which a Receipt Number Transfer Request would need to be submitted to SIG to move the existing Receipt Number from the original account holder to the new one, before proxy registration could proceed under the new name. Allion recommended proceeding with the existing Hosokawa account registration as the simpler path, given this added complexity.
consultant_answer: The account that issued the Invoice (and received the Receipt Number) has to be the same account used for the actual registration — the Receipt Number won't work for a registration under a different login. If you want to register under a different person's name instead, that person needs to first get their own valid SIG login account, and then we'd need to submit a Receipt Number Transfer Request to SIG to move the receipt to the new account before we could proceed under that name. We'd recommend just proceeding with the existing Hosokawa account, since that avoids this extra step.
decision_logic: Registration must be performed under the exact SIG account that issued the Invoice and received the Receipt Number, since Receipt Numbers are account-bound; switching the registering account requires an explicit SIG Receipt Number Transfer Request, adding process steps and delay compared to keeping the original account.
final_recommendation: When a customer asks about changing the registering account mid-process, clearly explain the Receipt Number's account-binding constraint and the transfer-request workaround, while recommending the simpler path (keeping the original account) unless there's a strong reason to switch.
risk_if_done_wrong: Attempting to register under a different account than the one that issued the Invoice, without first completing a Receipt Number Transfer Request, would cause the registration to fail since the Receipt Number wouldn't be valid for that account.
